title: Mufindi: Tea Estates in the Southern Highlands
excerpt: Mufindi in the Southern Highlands is a landscape of tea estates, forests and cool air. A relaxing stop on a southern route.
body:
## Landscape

Rolling hills with tea plantations, pine forests and natural forest.

## Activities

- Walks and mountain biking.
- Tea estate visits.
- Fishing in dams.
- Community projects.

## Climate

Cool, especially at night.

## Combine

With [Ruaha](/blog/ruaha-national-park-guide/) and [Iringa](/blog/iringa-guide/).

Read our [Mufindi page](/national-parks/mufindi-highlands/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
